description: This file contains a Smarty plugin defining a block function 'minify' that trims and compresses HTML, CSS, and inline styles to reduce size. It includes the main smarty_block_minify function and auxiliary functions for CSS minification.

methods.name: smarty_block_minify
methods.description: Main function registered as a Smarty block plugin that performs HTML minification by removing whitespace, comments, and optimizing inline CSS within HTML content.

methods.name: fn_minify_css
methods.description: Minifies CSS content by removing unnecessary spaces, comments, and optimizing color codes, with special handling for calc() expressions.

methods.name: __minify_v
methods.description: Helper function that replaces whitespace characters with appropriate whitespace or newlines for cleaner output in minified CSS.
